zh_CN: 用来翻地，把草地变成可耕种的土地。
给作物浇水，作物才会生长。
en: Waters crops so they keep growing.

zh_CN: 清除枯死的作物，也可以割草。
en: Clears withered crops and cuts weeds.

zh_CN: 这里长着东西，得先清理
WASD 或方向键选择 · A / D 换列表 · E 确认 · Esc 离开
en: WASD or arrows to select · A / D switch list · E to confirm · Esc to leave

zh_CN: 按 Tab 或 Esc 关闭
en: Press Tab or Esc to close

zh_CN: 欢迎光临，今天要买点什么吗？

en: I would like to buy something.

zh_CN: 有眼光！今天新到了几样好货。
en: Good eye! We just got some fresh stock.

zh_CN: 今天天气不错，地里的活儿会顺利的。
en: Nice weather today. Good for the fields.

zh_CN: 下雨天不用浇水，可以省点力气。
早啊，年轻人。农场就交给你了。
en: Morning. The farm is in your hands now.

zh_CN: 别忘了给作物浇水，不然它们会枯掉的。
en: Don't forget to water your crops or they wilt.

zh_CN: 换季的时候，能种的东西就变了。
en: When the season turns so do your crops.

zh_CN: 炉子正旺，要打把新家伙吗？
en: The forge is hot. Need a new tool?
You look great at the anvil.

zh_CN: 还行，庄稼人趁手就够用了。
en: Steady enough. Folks need what lasts.

zh_CN: 斧头和镐子要常磨，砍树砸石头才不费劲。
en: Keep your axe and pickaxe sharp.

zh_CN: 天冷了，铁也硬得快，干活得趁热。
en: Cold mornings make the iron bite faster.

zh_CN: 来挑几朵花吧，刚剪下来的。
野花也能卖钱，采下来别浪费。
en: Wildflowers sell too. Don't waste them.

zh_CN: 花儿谢了就不好看了，常来啊。
海风不小，今天浪有点大。
en: Brisk sea wind. The waves are high today.

zh_CN: 退潮的时候，沙滩上能捡到不少好东西。
en: At low tide the beach gives up its treasures.

zh_CN: 冬天鱼都往深水里躲喽。
en: In winter the fish hide in deep water.
It's dark in there. Stay close.

zh_CN: 带够镐子再来，石头可不客气。
en: Bring a pickaxe. The rocks won't be kind.

zh_CN: 洞里头不分四季，倒省心。
en: Down here it's the same all year round.

zh_CN: 你就是新来的农场主吗？
等会儿一起去广场玩吧！
en: Let's play at the plaza later!

zh_CN: 我妈妈说，浇水的时候要轻轻的。
en: My mom says water the crops gently.

zh_CN: 欢迎来到图书馆，请保持安静。
en: Welcome to the library. Please be quiet.

zh_CN: 想了解季节和作物，来这儿翻翻书准没错。
en: Books here explain seasons and crops.

zh_CN: 无论外面什么季节，书里都是安静的。
en: Books stay calm whatever the season.

zh_CN: 一个用 Godot 4 搭建的农场生活模拟原型
en: A farming-life prototype built with Godot 4

zh_CN: 方向键选择 · Enter 确认
en: Arrows to select · Enter to confirm

zh_CN: Enter 读取 · Delete 删除 · Esc 返回
en: Enter load · Delete remove · Esc back

zh_CN: 像素美术与像素字体均由脚本生成
en: Pixel art and font are generated by scripts

zh_CN: 传说中用来求婚的信物，送给心爱的人。
en: A legendary token used to propose to your beloved.

zh_CN: 今天已经给{npc}送过礼物了
背包里没有可送的东西
面前没有人可以送礼物

en: A child is born to your family!

zh_CN: 你来了。书我帮你留着呢，慢慢看。
en: You came. I saved these books for you.

zh_CN: 和你一起整理书架的时间，比看书还让我安心。
en: Shelving books with you calms me more than reading.

zh_CN: 回家啦？我炖了汤，就等你呢。
en: Welcome home. The soup is ready for you.

zh_CN: 我一直在等一个会认真听我说话的人。
en: I have been waiting for someone who truly listens.

zh_CN: 如果那个人是你……我愿意。
en: And if that someone is you... I would be glad.

zh_CN: 我愿意。以后每个故事里，都有你。
en: Yes. Every story from now on will have you in it.

zh_CN: 来，这朵最好看的，算婆婆送你的。
en: Here. The prettiest one is my gift to you.

zh_CN: 花开得好，是因为有人在等它开呢。
en: Flowers bloom because someone waits for them.

zh_CN: 家里有你在，比满园的花都热闹。
en: With you at home the whole garden feels warmer.

zh_CN: 老太婆我看人很准，你是个好孩子。
en: I read people well and you are a good soul.

zh_CN: 要是你不嫌弃……那就一起过日子吧。
en: If you do not mind... let us share our days.
Oh my. This feather... are you sure?

zh_CN: 好，好。往后花园里，多你一个。
en: Wonderful. One more pair of hands in the garden.

zh_CN: 今天的浪不大，要不要跟我出海？
en: Calm water today. Want to sail with me?

zh_CN: 再大的风浪，想到岸上有人等，就不怕了。
en: No matter the storm I am calm knowing you wait ashore.

zh_CN: 回来啦，鱼我收拾好了，你歇着。
en: You are back. The fish is cleaned. Take a rest.

zh_CN: 我在海上漂了半辈子，头回这么想靠岸。
en: I have sailed half my life and never wanted to dock like this.

zh_CN: 你要是不嫌弃，我想把船停在你心里。
en: If you will have me I would anchor my boat in your heart.

zh_CN: 这蓝羽毛……你从哪儿弄来的？
en: This blue feather... where did you get it?

zh_CN: 我收下了。往后风里雨里，都有我。
en: I accept. Through wind and rain you have me.

zh_CN: 你这家伙结实，来，给你打的东西刚出炉。
en: You are a sturdy sort. Your order is fresh from the forge.

zh_CN: 敲了一整天铁，最想见的还是你。
en: After a day at the anvil you are still who I want to see.

zh_CN: 回来啦？炉火我留着，暖手。
en: Back already? I kept the forge warm for you.

zh_CN: 我嘴笨，敲铁比说话利索。
en: I am clumsy with words but handy with a hammer.

zh_CN: 可这句我练了很久——我喜欢你。
en: But I practiced this one. I like you.

zh_CN: 这……你拿蓝羽毛来做什么？
好。往后我打的每样东西，都有你一半。
en: Then so be it. Everything I forge is half yours.
Press E to join the festival

zh_CN: 新年好！今年也请多关照。
en: Happy new year! Please look after us again.

zh_CN: 广场上摆好了酒，大家就等你来了。
en: The drinks are out on the plaza. Everyone is waiting.

zh_CN: 今年的花祭，来看看婆婆新剪的花吧。
en: Come see my freshly cut flowers for the flower festival.

zh_CN: 花开得这么好，都是托你的福。
en: The flowers bloom like this thanks to you.

zh_CN: 快看快看，烟花要开始了！
column4: the fireworks are about to start!

zh_CN: 夏天的晚上，就该和大家一起看烟花。
en: Summer nights are for fireworks with friends.

zh_CN: 今年的收成不错，大家都能过个好年。
en: A fine harvest this year. We will all be warm.

zh_CN: 这些饭菜都是用你的作物做的，多吃点。
en: Everything here is made from your crops. Eat up.

zh_CN: 今晚的星星特别亮，许个愿吧。
en: The stars are bright tonight. Make a wish.

zh_CN: 听说在星夜祭许的愿，一定会实现。
en: They say wishes made at the starry night come true.

zh_CN: 一位旅人路过农场，留下 {money}G 谢礼
en: A traveler passed the farm and left {money}G
The mayor sent a {money}G summer grant

zh_CN: 镇公所送来了丰收的谢礼 {money}G
en: The town hall sent {money}G for the good harvest

zh_CN: 初雪落下了，冬天到了。农场也安静下来。
en: The first snow fell. Winter has come.

zh_CN: 书雅带了几本书来，想和你聊聊。
en: Shuyai brought some books and wants to talk.

zh_CN: 对着水面按空格抛竿，咬钩时再按一次收竿
en: Pull it out at the water and reel in on the bite

zh_CN: 咬钩了！再按一次空格收竿
en: It is biting! Press Space again
